source: tempopt.c:5792-6067 LevelCompleteStartup/Update, HUD.C:2522 HUDGetDigits, FROG.C:2833-2842; FROGGER.EXE 0x00444dc0 and 0x0043e580 for the music

exe_pins.meaning: LevelCompleteStartup, next level: MRSNDPlaySound(SFX_MUSIC_LEVEL_COMPLETE) at 0x0044c290, then PauseCD at 0x00430110, then past the zone-complete block
LevelCompleteStartup, zone complete: with Sound_volume set, MRSNDSetVolumeLevel(MRSND_CD_VOLUME, 127 * Sound_volume / 8), then PlayZoneComplete at 0x0043e580, with no StopCD first
PlayZoneComplete: PlayCD(Game_map_theme + 22, 0): the zone tune once
StopCD: with a CD and a track playing, the MCI stop at 0x00446580
PauseCD: unless already paused, set the paused flag and jump to the same MCI stop; the track is kept

exe_absent_calls.meaning: the zone-complete block plays no sound: no MRSNDPlaySound, so no sound 8
